script: Let's take a look at this week's weather forecast!
We're starting the week off mild on Monday, with a high of 74 degrees. Expect partly sunny skies, a morning low of 65, and a 14 percent chance of rain.
Tuesday stays about the same, with a high of 72. Expect partly sunny skies, a morning low of 59, and no rain.
Wednesday warms up to 76 degrees. Expect partly sunny skies, a morning low of 62, and no rain.
Thursday warms up to 80 degrees. Expect mostly cloudy skies, a morning low of 67, and an 11 percent chance of rain.
Friday warms up to 83 degrees. Expect mostly cloudy skies, a morning low of 69, and no rain.
weather.source: National Weather Service, La Joya TX
notes: Friday comes from NWS grid data because the 7-day text forecast doesn't reach it yet. These numbers can still change, so rerun the morning of recording.
